acceptanceCriteria: The v0.2.40 tag and public Release are produced from the reviewed synchronized main merge and all release identity, SBOM, provenance, and checksum gates pass.
The public v0.2.40 artifact is downloaded and checksum-verified in an isolated environment with runtime tag/version/archiveDigest/binaryDigest/platform/downloadSource recorded.

A fresh adopter receives independent repository identity/scaffold/Agent adapter and a complete lifecycle; first-adopter-smoke remains not_ready, evidence reuse is proven, and forbidden roots plus temporary run roots are clean.
The current repository installs the verified public v0.2.40 binary, reports COMPATIBLE/doctor ok, and retains auditable acceptance artifacts while main ends ready_on_base with no open release branch.
goal: Establish the v0.2.40 public Release and prove the installed shared Runtime can govern both this repository and a fresh independent adopter with bound evidence.
intent: Publish v0.2.40 from the reviewed main merge and validate the immutable public binary in an isolated fresh adopter, then install it for current-repository governance.
outOfScope: Reference-source parity batch and business-project code
Source-build or workspace-binary fallback as Release evidence
